q: The indirect speech of: She said to me, "Where were you born?''
o: She asked me where I had been born.
She asked me whether I had born.
She wanted to know where I were born.
She asked me where I was born.

q: He said, 'Good morning, Habib.' Make indirect speech
o: He told Habib good morning.
He had wish Habib good morning.
He said Habib good morning.
He wished Habib good morning.

q: He said that he ____ attend the class. Use correct form of tense in the blank.
o: will
would
shall
may
e:
‘He said that…’ বাক্যে মূল verb said, অর্থাৎ Past Tense-এ আছে। নিয়ম হলো, মূল verb past হলে that-এর পরের clause-এর modal verb-ও past form-এ যায়। Will-এর past form would, তাই সঠিক বাক্য He said that he would attend the class। এটি আসলে Indirect speech-এর নিয়ম, কারণ সরাসরি উক্তিতে সে বলেছিল ‘I will attend the class’।
Shall ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝায়, কিন্তু সাধারণ ব্যবহারে এটি প্রথম পুরুষের (I, we) সঙ্গে বসে, আর এখানে ‘he’ আছে। May বসালে অর্থ হয় সম্ভাবনা, যা বাক্যের ভাবের সঙ্গে মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন: Indirect speech-এ will → would, can → could, may → might, shall → should।
s: দ্য সিকিউরিটি প্রিন্টিং কর্পোরেশন (বাংলাদেশ), সহকারী ব্যবস্থাপক (২০২১)

q: Rahat said to me, "Can you lend me some books now?" (Indirect)
o: Rahat asked me if I can lend him some books now.
Rahat said to me whether I could lend him some books now.
Rahat asked me whether I could lend him some books now.
Rahat asked me whether I could lend him some books then.

q: My father said to me, “We are going there tomorrow.” The indirect speech will be:
o: My father told me that they would be going there the next day
My father said to me that they are going there the next day
My father told me that they were going there the next day
My father told me that they are going there the next day
e: Said to me হলে indirect-এ told me বসে। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় are going বদলে were going হয়, tomorrow বদলে the next day হয়, আর we বদলে they (বক্তা ও তার পরিবার) হয়। তাই “My father told me that they were going there the next day”। ‘said to me that’ ও ‘are going’ কাল ও গঠনের দিক থেকে ভুল।

q: You said to me, "Would you help me, please?" বাক্যের সঠিক indirect speech -
o: You politely ask me if I would help you.
You politely asked me that if I should help you.
You politely asked me that whether I would help you.
You politely asked me if I would help you
e: 'please' থাকায় 'politely asked' লেখা হয়, আর yes/no প্রশ্ন বলে সংযোজক 'if' বসে (if-এর আগে that বসে না)। সর্বনাম বদলে: You politely asked me if I would help you।

q: Angel said, “I bought a pen yesterday.”
o: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that I had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she has bought a pen the day before
e: Past indefinite (bought) reporting verb past হলে past perfect (had bought) হয়, আর yesterday বদলে the day before হয়। I বদলে বক্তা Angel অনুযায়ী she হয়। সঠিক রূপ: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before। I রেখে দিলে person ভুল, ‘bought’ রেখে দিলে কাল বদলানো হয়নি, আর ‘has bought’ present perfect, যা past reporting verb-এর সাথে চলে না।

q: 'Do you work from home?' he said. (make it indirect)
o: He said to me if I worked from home.
He asked me if I have worked from home.
He told me if I worked from home.
He asked me if I worked from home.

q: Choose the correct indirect narration of the sentence: Mina said to her brother, "Do not touch my laptop."
o: Mina requested her brother that he should not touch her laptop.
Mina told her brother that he did not touch her laptop.
Mina forbade her brother to touch her laptop.
Mina said to her brother not to touch my laptop.

q: Change the narration : She asked me, "Are you happy with your life?"
o: She asked me if I am happy with my life.
She asked me if I was happy with my life.
She asked me if I had been happy with my life.
She asked me if I were happy with my life.
e:
Yes/No প্রশ্নকে (যার উত্তর হ্যাঁ বা না) indirect speech-এ বদলাতে reporting verb asked বসে এবং if বা whether দিয়ে reported অংশ শুরু হয়। Reporting verb অতীত কালের (asked) হলে reported অংশের present tense বদলে past tense হয়ে যায়। তাই Are you happy হয়ে যায় I was happy। আর you বদলে I হয়, কারণ you আসলে প্রশ্নকর্তা যাঁকে বলছেন, সেই ব্যক্তি, অর্থাৎ me। বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায়: She asked me if I was happy with my life.
মনে রাখুন: প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) indirect speech-এ বাদ যায়।
s: বাংলাদেশ রেলওয়ে, উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী ও অন্যান্য পদ (২০২৪)

q: Lisa said, "I must talk to the director about the project." (change the narration)
o: Lisa said that she had to talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she has to talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she had talk to the director about the project.

q: 'Man is mortal' বাক্যটির Indirect speech কোনটি?
o: He said that mortal is man .
Man is mortal that he said.
He said that man is mortal.
The mortal is a man.

q: Rajib said to me, "Let us go to the party together."
o: Rajib proposed to me to go to the party together.
Rajib urged to me that to go to the party together.
Rajib asked to me that we should go to the party together.
Rajib proposed to me that we should go to the party together.

q: Change the following sentence into an indirect sentence: Rupa said to me, "Why are you working so hard?"
o: Rupa told me why I was working so hard.
Rupa asked me why I was working so hard.
Rupa asked me why I work so hard.
Rupa asked me why I am working so hard.

q: Helena said, "I took the laptop home with me". [indirect]
o: Helena told that she had the laptop taken home with her.
Helena confirmed that she has taken the laptop home with her.
Helena said that she took the laptop home with her.
Helena said that she had taken the laptop home with her.

q: He asked me ___ the place until she comes back
o: to not leave
not to leave
do not leave
to no leave
e: Reported command বা অনুরোধে negative বোঝাতে not to + base verb বসে, তাই not to leave সঠিক। অর্থ: সে আমাকে বলল সে ফিরে না আসা পর্যন্ত জায়গাটি ছেড়ে না যেতে। To not leave কিছু ক্ষেত্রে ব্যবহৃত হলেও শুদ্ধ রূপ not to leave। Do not leave সরাসরি উক্তির রূপ, আর to no leave ভুল। Asked + object + (not) to-infinitive হলো indirect request-এর গঠন।

q: He said, “We must colour the house next year.” (Make in Indirect)
o: He said that they would colour the house the following year.
He said that they would have to colour the house the following year.
He said that we colour the h house the following year.
He said that they must have to colour the house the following year.

q: The teacher said to the students, “Always obey your parents.” (Change into indirect speech)
o: The teacher ordered the students not to obey their parents.
The teacher told the students always obey their parents.
The teacher advised the students to always obey their parents.
The teacher said the students that always obey their parents.

q: Which is the Indirect speech of the following sentence- He said to me, 'Have you passed?'
o: He asked me if I passed
He asked me if I have passed
He asked me did I pass
He asked me if I had passed

q: What is the correct indirect form of: I said to him, “You had better speak the truth”.
o: He proposed to speaking the truth.
I advised that he had better spoken the truth.
I suggested that he had spoken the truth better.
I advised him to speak the truth.

q: The Captain ordered the soldiers to march on. বাক্যের direct speech হবে
o: The Captain asked, "Soldiers, I ask you to march"
The Captain said to the soldiers, "Please march on"
The Captain said, "Soldiers, I ask you to march on"
The Captain said to the soldiers, "March on"

q: Mother said to him, "Did you finish your homework?"
o: Mother told him if he had finished his homework.
Mother asked him if he had finished his homework.
Mother told him if he finished his homework.
Mother asked him if he finished his homework.

q: Find the correct indirect speech of— The teacher said to Alam, "Work regularly"
o: The teacher advised Alam to work regularly
The teacher said to Alam to work regularly
The teacher told to Alam to working regularly
The teacher said Alam to work regularly
e:
Imperative বাক্য direct থেকে indirect করার সময় reporting verb ‘said to’ অনুরোধ বা পরামর্শের ভাবের ওপর নির্ভর করে বদলে যায়। উপদেশ বোঝালে ‘advised’, আদেশ হলে ‘ordered’, অনুরোধ হলে ‘requested’ হয়। এরপর inverted comma-র ভেতরের অংশ ‘to + verb’ হয়ে যায়। তাই: The teacher advised Alam to work regularly। বাকি অপশনগুলোতে ‘said to … to’, ‘told to Alam’ বা ‘said Alam to’ বসেছে, যা ব্যাকরণসম্মত নয়।
উদাহরণ:
He said to me, “Please help me.” → He requested me to help him.
মনে রাখুন: Negative imperative হলে ‘not to + verb’ বসে।

q: He said to me, “Come here.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He told me come here
He told that I should come here
He ordered me that I go there
He told me to go there
e: Imperative (আদেশ) বাক্যের indirect-এ said to বদলে told/ordered/requested বসে, আর আদেশের verb হয় to-infinitive। Here বদলে there হয়, আর বক্তার দিক থেকে দূরে যাওয়া বোঝাতে come প্রায়ই go হয়ে যায়। তাই “He told me to go there” (সে আমাকে সেখানে যেতে বলল)। “told me come” ভুল, কারণ to ছাড়া verb বসেছে, আর “ordered me that” গঠন ভুল।

q: He said, "Let the children play outside." (Make it indirect)
o: He proposed that the children could play outside.
He said that the children might play outside.
He told that the children can play outside.
He suggested that the children may play outside.

q: Put the following sentence into indirect speech: “Why are you getting wet in the rain?” I said.
o: I told why he was getting wet in the rain
I asked why he were getting wet in the rain
I asked why he was getting wet in the rain
I asked were why he getting wet in the rain
e: প্রশ্নের indirect-এ reporting verb হয় asked, আর Wh-শব্দ (why) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। Are getting বদলে was getting হয়, কারণ reporting verb past, আর you বদলে he হয় (যাকে বলা হয়েছে)। তাই “I asked why he was getting wet in the rain”। Told প্রশ্নের জন্য ভুল, ‘he were’ কর্তা-ক্রিয়ার মিলে ভুল, আর শেষ অপশনে শব্দক্রম এলোমেলো।

q: They asserted that ___
o: he conducted the test previous day
he has conducted the test previous day
he did conduct the test previous day
he had conducted the test previous day
e: Asserted অতীত, তাই Indirect Speech-এ পরের অংশ এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়, এবং আগের ঘটনা হিসেবে had conducted বসে। অর্থ: তারা জোর দিয়ে বলল যে সে আগের দিন পরীক্ষাটি চালিয়েছিল। Conducted, has conducted ও did conduct অতীতের আগের ঘটনা বোঝাতে অসম্পূর্ণ। Reported speech-এ yesterday হয় the previous day, tomorrow হয় the next day।

q: Shohel said, "Every day I read newspapers." (Indirect speech)
o: Shohel had said that he reads newspapers.
Shohel said that every day he read newspapers.
Shohel says that he reads newspapers.
Shohel said that every day he reads newspapers.

q: He said, "I went to Khulna". The indirect speech is—
o: He said that he went to Khulna
He said that he had gone to Khulna
He said that he has gone to Khulna
He said that he would go to Khulna
e:
Direct speech-এর reporting verb ‘said’ অতীতকালের হলে, indirect speech-এ উদ্ধৃতাংশের tense এক ধাপ পেছনে যায়। উদ্ধৃতাংশ ‘I went to Khulna’ হলো Past Indefinite, তাই indirect-এ সেটি Past Perfect হয়। আবার উত্তম পুরুষ ‘I’ প্রথম বাক্যের subject ‘He’-এর সঙ্গে মিলে ‘he’ হয়। ফলে বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায়: He said that he had gone to Khulna। Past Indefinite থেকে Past Perfect না হলে অতীতের আগের ঘটনা বোঝানো যায় না।
মনে রাখুন:
Present Indefinite → Past Indefinite।
Past Indefinite → Past Perfect।
Will → would।
Can → could।
s: ফরেন সার্ভিস একাডেমি (পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়), প্রশাসনিক ব্যক্তিগত কর্মকর্তা (২০২৫)

q: The indirect form of the sentence - Farida said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now." is -
o: Farida told her mother that she would go to bed then.
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed now.
Farida told her mother that she should go to bed.
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed.
e: Reporting verb past হওয়ায় shall হয় would, I হয় she, আর সময়বাচক now হয় then। said to-কে told করা হয়।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (২০১৪ সালের স্থগিত পরীক্ষা, ১৫ জেলা) (২০১৮)

q: He said to me, "Are you sleeping now?"(Make it Indirect)
o: He asked me whether I was sleeping then.
He asked me whether he was sleeping then.
He asked me whether I was sleeping now.
He asked me whether I had been sleeping now.

q: It seemed that ___
o: the day will never end
the day would never end
the day never ends
the day never ended
e: Seemed অতীত, তাই পরের clause-এ অতীতের দৃষ্টিকোণে ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝাতে would never end সঠিক। অর্থ: মনে হচ্ছিল দিনটি কখনও শেষ হবে না। Will never end ও never ends বর্তমান রূপ, যা অতীতের সাথে মেলে না। Never ended শুধু অতীত বোঝায়, ভবিষ্যতের ভাব দেয় না। আসন্ন সময়ের আশঙ্কা বোঝাতে would ব্যবহার হয়।

q: The indirect speech of Mother said to me, "Did you spread the rumour?"
o: Mother asked to me if I had spread the rumour.
Mother asked me if I spread the rumour.
Mother asked me whether I had spread the rumour.
Mother asked me whether I had spreaded the rumour.
e: Yes/No প্রশ্নের indirect speech-এ said to বদলে asked হয়, সঙ্গে if বা whether বসে এবং বাক্য statement-এর order নেয়। Past Indefinite (spread) বদলে Past Perfect (had spread) হয়। সঠিক উত্তর 'Mother asked me whether I had spread the rumour.'। অর্থ: মা আমাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলেন আমি গুজবটি ছড়িয়েছি কি না। 'asked to me' ভুল, কারণ asked-এর পরে to বসে না; 'spreaded' ভুল, কারণ spread-এর V3 আলাদা হয় না (spread-spread-spread)।

q: He said to me, "Regular exercise is good for health." Make it indirect speech.
o: He told me that regular exercise is good for health.
He told me that regular exercise is to be good for health.
He told me that regular exercise was good for health.
He told me that regular exercise is best for health.
e: Reported speech যদি চিরন্তন সত্য বা সাধারণ সত্য হয়, তাহলে reporting verb অতীতকালের হলেও তার tense বদলায় না। 'Regular exercise is good for health' তেমন একটি সত্য, তাই is অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। আর said to হয়ে যায় told। সঠিক উত্তর 'He told me that regular exercise is good for health.'। অর্থ: নিয়মিত ব্যায়াম স্বাস্থ্যের জন্য ভালো। 'was good' দিলে সত্যটি অতীতের মনে হয়, আর 'best' দিলে অর্থ বদলে যায়।

q: "Close the door," he ordered. বাক্যের সঠিক indirect speech:
o: He ordered to close the door.
He ordered the door to be closed.
He told close the door.
He ordered that to close the door.

q: Choose the indirect speech of - She said to me, "Will you go there?"
o: She asked me whether I would go there.
She asked me would I go there.
She asked me when will I go there.
She asked me when I would go there.

q: He said, “I have been working since sunrise.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He said that he has been working since sunrise
He said that he has worked for sunrise
He said that he had been working since sunrise
He said that he is working since sunrise
e: Reported speech present perfect continuous (have been working) হলে reporting verb past থাকলে indirect-এ তা past perfect continuous (had been working) হয়। Person-এ I হয় he। তাই “He said that he had been working since sunrise” (সে বলল সূর্যোদয় থেকে সে কাজ করছিল)। বাকি অপশনে tense বদলানো হয়নি অথবা অর্থ নষ্ট হয়েছে, যেমন “for sunrise”।

q: 'Aref told us that he had waited and hour'- বাক্যটির direct speech হবে-
o: Aref said to us, 'I had to wait an hour.'
Aref said to us, 'I have been waiting an hour.'
Aref said to us, 'I waited an hour.'
Aref told to us, 'I have waited an hour.'

q: I said to him, "Will you follow me?" বাক্যের সঠিক Indirect speech-
o: I said to him if he would follow me.
I asked him if he would follow me.
I asked to him if he would follow me.
I said to him if he will follow me.
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নের ক্ষেত্রে said to বদলে asked এবং সংযোজক if বসে। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় will হয় would: I asked him if he would follow me।

q: Which one is correct: He said to me ''May you be happy''
o: He told that I might be happy.
He reported that I might be happy.
He said that I might be happy.
He wished that I might be happy.
e: May দিয়ে শুভকামনা প্রকাশ করলে indirect-এ reporting verb wished বা prayed হয় এবং may হয় might; তাই He wished that I might be happy।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (১ম ধাপ) (২০১৫)

q: John said to me, 'Thank you' [change the narration]
o: John thanks you.
John thanked you.
John thanks me.
John thanked me.

q: She said, 'Let me come in.' Which of the following is correct indirect form-
o: She requested that she may be allowed to come in
She requested that she might come in
She said that she come in
She requested that she may come in
e: Let দিয়ে অনুমতি চাওয়া বোঝালে indirect speech-এ said পরিবর্তিত হয়ে requested হয় এবং may-এর past রূপ might বসে। তাই She requested that she might come in।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (মুক্তিযোদ্ধা কোটা) (২০১৬)

q: Change the speech: “I don’t know the way. Do you?” she asked.
o: She said that she didn’t know the way and did I know it
She said that she didn’t know the way and asked me if I did
She told that she was not knowing the way, but wondered if I knew
She asked me if I knew the way which she didn’t
e: বাক্যে একটি বিবৃতি আর একটি yes/no প্রশ্ন আছে। বিবৃতি হয় she said that she didn’t know the way, আর প্রশ্ন হয় asked me if I did (know it)। দুটি অংশ and দিয়ে যুক্ত হয়ে সঠিক রূপ তৈরি হয়। প্রথম অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, তৃতীয়টিতে ‘not knowing’ ভুল (know stative verb), আর চতুর্থটিতে অর্থ বদলে গেছে।

q: He said to me, “Do you like music?” The indirect form of this sentence is:
o: He said if I like music
He asked me do I like music
He asked to me if I like music
He asked me if I liked music
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নে said to বদলে asked হয় এবং যোজক বসে if বা whether। প্রশ্নের ক্রম ছেড়ে বিবৃতির ক্রম চলে: I liked music। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় like বদলে liked হয়, আর you হয় I। তাই “He asked me if I liked music”। Said প্রশ্নের জন্য ঠিক নয়, “asked me do I” প্রশ্নের ক্রম রেখে দিয়েছে, আর ‘asked to me’ ভুল।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to Rafi, “May you achieve success.”
o: The teacher wished that Rafi might achieve success.
The teacher wished Rafi to achieved success.
The teacher prayed that Rafi may achieved success.
The teacher hoped that Rafi will achieve success.
e: "May you achieve success" শুভকামনা প্রকাশ করে, তাই indirect-এ said বদলে wished বসে। Quotation চিহ্নের জায়গায় that আসে, reporting verb past হওয়ায় may বদলে might হয়, আর you বদলে শ্রোতা Rafi নাম বসে। Might-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ (achieve) থাকে। সঠিক রূপ: The teacher wished that Rafi might achieve success. Hoped-এর সঙ্গে will দিলে past-এর নিয়ম ভাঙে (would লাগত), আর achieved বা to achieved ব্যাকরণগতভাবে অশুদ্ধ।

q: He said to me, “What a fool you are!”. (Make it indirect)
o: He exclaimed with wonder that I am a great fool.
He exclaimed with wonder what a great fool I am.
He exclaimed with wonder what a fool I am.
He exclaimed with wonder that I was a great fool.

q: What is the indirect form of: The headmistress says, "The school will remain closed tomorrow."?
o: The headmistress says that the school will remain closed the next day.
The headmistress says that the school would remain closed the next day.
The headmistress says that the school will be remain closed the next day.
The headmistress told that the school would remain closed the next day.

q: Change the narration. He said to him, "Is not your name Ahmed?"
o: I told him that his name is Ahmed.
He enquired whether his name was not Ahmed.
He exclaimed is not your name Ahmed?
He said that his name was Ahmed.
e: Yes/No প্রশ্ন indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে asked বা enquired হয় এবং whether বা if বসে। Present Indefinite (is) বদলে Past Indefinite (was) হয় আর your বদলে his হয়। উত্তর 'He enquired whether his name was not Ahmed.'। অর্থ: সে তাকে জিজ্ঞেস করল তার নাম আহমেদ কি না। বাকি অপশনে বাক্যটি প্রশ্ন থেকে সাধারণ বিবৃতি হয়ে গেছে, তাই ভুল। প্রশ্নের narration-এ question mark থাকে না।

q: I said to him, “May Allah grant you a long life”. (Make it indirect)
o: I wished him Allah may grant him a long life.
I wished him Allah might grant him a long life.
I prayed to him that Allah might grant him a long life.
I wished him may Allah grant him a long life.

q: Which of the following is the indirect form of: “The teacher said to me, ‘You are doing well in class.’”?
o: The teacher said to me that I was doing well in class.
The teacher told me that I was doing well in class.
The teacher told me that I am doing well in class.
The teacher said that I was doing well in class.

q: Put the following sentence into indirect narration: ''You had better not leave your room unlocked'' said my friends.
o: My friends asked me not to leave my room unlocked
My friends reminded me to lock my room
My friends advised me to lock my room
My friends warned me not to leave my room unlocked
e: ‘Had better’ দিয়ে পরামর্শ দেওয়া বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ reporting verb হয় advised। ‘ঘর খোলা রেখো না’ মানেই ‘ঘর তালা দিয়ে রেখো’, তাই advised me to lock my room সঠিক।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (আলফা) (২০১৪)

q: Change into the indirect speech: He said, “I will help you.”
o: He said he would helped me.
He said that I would help you.
He said that he will help me.
He said that he would help me.

q: She said, “Good night.” (Make it indirect)
o: She greeted to me good night.
She wished me good night.
She told me good night.
She said to me good night.

q: The direct speech of the sentence “He asked Karim to go with him” is:
o: He said to Karim, “Go with me.”
He told Karim, “Go with him.”
He asked Karim, “Go with his.”
He said to Karim, “Go with he.”
e: Indirect-এ asked someone to ... থাকলে direct-এ সাধারণত said to someone, “আদেশ বা অনুরোধ” হয়। Indirect-এর him (বক্তা নিজে) direct-এ me হয়, আর verb to ছাড়া বসে: “Go with me.” তাই “He said to Karim, ‘Go with me.’” সঠিক। Go with him বা go with his বসালে অন্য কাউকে বোঝায়, আর “go with he” case-এর দিক থেকে ভুল।

q: He said, "Alas! The storm has destroyed our crops."
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that the storm destroyed our crops.
He exclaimed with sorrow that the storm had destroyed our crops.
He exclaimed with sorrow that the storm has destroyed their crops.
He exclaimed with sorrow that the storm had destroyed their crops.

q: The man said, 'Good morning my friends' বাক্যটির Indirect speech হবে-
o: The man bade his friends good morning
The man wished his friends good morning
The man had told his friends good morning
The man wishes his friends good morning
e: Good morning, Good night ধরনের শুভেচ্ছা পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে নিতে reporting verb হিসেবে wished বসে: The man wished his friends good morning.

q: Change the speech: The old man said to me, "Will you help me?"
o: The old man told me whether I will help him.
The old man asked me if I would help him.
The old man asked me will I help him.
The old man demanded my help.

q: The mother said to her son, “May you pass the examination.” The indirect speech is:
o: The mother wished her son that he might pass the examination
The mother said to her son that he might pass the examination
The mother wished that her son might pass the examination
The mother wished her son that he may pass the examination
e: শুভকামনা বোঝাতে indirect-এ wished + that + subject + might + verb বসে, আর wished-এর পরে সরাসরি object বসে না। তাই “The mother wished that her son might pass the examination”। ‘Wished her son that he’ ইংরেজিতে চলে না। Said to ... সাধারণ উক্তির রূপ, কামনার ভাব নেই। আর may কাল না বদলানোয় চতুর্থ অপশন ভুল।

q: Which of the following is the correct indirect form of the given direct speech? “What do you want”? He said to me.
o: He asked me what I wanted.
He asked me what I had wanted.
He asked me what I want.
He asked me what do you want.
e:
প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যকে Indirect করতে said to বদলে asked হয়, প্রশ্নবোধক শব্দ what রেখে বাক্যকে assertive ক্রমে সাজাতে হয়। Reporting verb অতীতে থাকায় present indefinite (want) বদলে past indefinite (wanted) হয়, আর you বদলে I। তাই উত্তর He asked me what I wanted।
মনে রাখুন: Indirect speech-এ do বা did সহায়ক ক্রিয়া বাদ পড়ে এবং প্রশ্নচিহ্নের জায়গায় দাঁড়ি বসে।

q: Change it into indirect speech: "Are you smiling?" Rizvi asked her.
o: Rizvi asked to her that if she was smiling.
Rizvi asked her that if she is smiling.
Rizvi asked her if she was smiling.
Rizvi asked her that whether she was smiling.
